metadata.description: Live-captured GET /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/device-status against the same deployment used for the sibling Updates captures, before teardown. Named _success (not just "count.json") so this genuinely-different-scenario fixture sorts AFTER the pre-existing updates_device_status_count_no_deployment.json in a full-corpus directory scan -- the two fixtures share an identical generic-template endpoint with no distinguishing query params, so RequestMatcher keeps the first-loaded (alphabetically earlier) response on a tied score; this naming keeps the no-deployment 404 case winning that tie for the shared-corpus test (TestGeneratedUpdatesV1ReadOnly), while a dedicated isolated-mock-server test exercises this success fixture directly by path (TestGeneratedUpdatesV1GetCountOfDeviceStatusSuccess), same pattern as updates_deployment_create_conflict.json.
